questions.subject: STATISTICS
questions.learningObjective: State the null hypothesis for a slope test
questions.stem: In a slope test, what is the usual null hypothesis?

options.misconception: one is not the default null
R-squared is not the parameter tested

questions.explanation: The default null is that the slope is zero, implying no linear relationship. Testing intercept or R-squared is different.

questions.subject: STATISTICS
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish confidence interval from prediction interval
questions.stem: Which interval is wider: prediction interval or confidence interval for the mean?

options.text: The confidence interval is wider because it covers the mean
The prediction interval is wider because it includes individual error
They are equal when sample size is large

questions.explanation: Prediction intervals are wider because they add individual error variance. Confidence intervals for the mean exclude it.

questions.explanation: A mean-response CI covers the average y at a given x. It is narrower than a prediction interval for one observation.

questions.subject: STATISTICS
